fit.model: batman, circular orbit, quadratic limb darkening, integrated over 30.0-minute exposures, with a quadratic baseline under each transit, marginalised

density_check.note: fitted density against the star's; a transit that needs a very different density suggests an eclipsing binary, a blend or an eccentric orbit

fit.interval_note: median with the central 68% (lower, upper) and 95% (lower95, upper95) posterior intervals
